title: A CDK1 phospho-switch reprograms TRAIP to unload replisomes in mitosis
authors: Can G; Shyian M; Krishnamoorthy A; Ahmed S; Lim Y; Wu RA; Pavani R; Zaher MS; Nussenzweig A; Räschle M; Wilson TE; Glover TW; Walter JC; Pellman D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CDK1磷酸化调控TRAIP在细胞有丝分裂中卸载复制体，属于细胞周期与DNA复制机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cells entering mitosis with incompletely replicated DNA face catastrophic chromosome segregation failure. During interphase, the replisome-associated E3 ubiquitin ligase TRAIP ubiquitylates barriers in front of the fork to allow replisome progression. In mitosis, TRAIP is reprogrammed from a trans -acting to a cis -acting ligase that can ubiquitylate the replisome itself. This enables the processing of unreplicated DNA by promoting replisome disassembly, fork breakage, and joining of the broken chromosome arms. Here, we describe a mechanism for this reprogramming: the ATPase TTF2 is recruited to the replisome, where its non-catalytic N-terminal domain tethers Cyclin B-CDK1-phosphorylated TRAIP to the leading strand DNA polymerase ε in a geometry that allows replisome ubiquitylation. Thus, a phospho-regulated architectural switch alters replisome organization in mitosis to safeguard genome integrity before chromosome segregation.
abstract_zh: 携带未完全复制DNA进入有丝分裂的细胞面临灾难性的染色体分离失败。在间期，与复制体相关的E3泛素连接酶TRAIP泛素化复制叉前方的障碍，以允许复制体前进。在有丝分裂中，TRAIP被重新编程，从反式作用连接酶转变为顺式作用连接酶，能够泛素化复制体本身。这通过促进复制体解体、复制叉断裂以及断裂染色体臂的连接，来处理未复制的DNA。在此，我们描述了这种重编程的机制：ATP酶TTF2被招募到复制体，其非催化N端结构域以允许复制体泛素化的几何结构，将Cyclin B-CDK1磷酸化的TRAIP拴系到前导链DNA聚合酶ε上。因此，一个磷酸化调控的结构开关改变了有丝分裂中复制体的组织，以在染色体分离前保障基因组完整性。
